errors.evidence: The x-axis range ends at 125,000, as shown by the last tick mark. The description incorrectly states the range extends to 127,000.
For the blue line (SepLLM (n=128)), the loss value at 100,000 iterations is approximately 2.55, not 2.58-2.60. The described range overestimates the value.
The upward spike on the orange line just after 100,000 iterations reaches a peak loss value of approximately 2.63, which is significantly lower than the stated 2.8.
The description fails to mention the shaded areas surrounding each of the three solid lines. This is a key visual feature representing variance or confidence intervals of the data.
